items.title: Student J's Career Journey
items.content: Commissioned by J's mother, we tailored a career path based on his interests and schedule, matched him with corporate and on-campus partner projects, exposed him to top-tier research programs and big-tech opportunities, and trained him on interview technique. J landed an offer at his dream big-tech company.

items.title: Professional L's Comeback
items.content: After being laid off and rejected over 100 times, we overhauled L's interview approach — positioning, technique, and storytelling — and helped him return to the workforce with a strong offer.
